selected_skill.name: clickhouse-io
selected_skill.rationale: High-star Data Engineering skill focused on ClickHouse analytical workloads, query optimization, table design, ingestion, window functions, and data engineering best practices.

design_summary.task_shape: Executable ClickHouse data pipeline over logistics package scans, order events, inventory snapshots, and reference data.
design_summary.environment: Single-container ClickHouse environment with gzipped CSV, gzipped JSONL, reference contracts, runner script, and bound environment/skills scaffold.
design_summary.with_without_delta: The with_skill and without_skill runtime copies differ only by environment/skills and the Dockerfile COPY skills lines.

main_tests: Run /app/workspace/run.sh --output /app/answer on the default data set.
Compare all output files against an independent Python oracle.
Validate schema, numeric metrics, SLA statuses, local business dates, wave grouping, and data quality summary.
guardrail_tests: Run alternate temporary data directories for tie-break, DST, deduplication, and stockout cases.
Reject static-answer and non-ClickHouse bypass patterns in runner and SQL source.
Require the bound ClickHouse scaffold path and provenance marker.
Validate the input data checksum when available.
